claim_elements.technical_feature: Motor mount with tuned vibration damper
claim_elements.structural_requirement: The motor mount has a tuned vibration damper integrated into its structure.
claim_elements.functional_requirement: The tuned vibration damper is configured to interact with the motor and blower to reduce motor vibration and stress on bearings.
claim_elements.relationship: The motor mount is adapted to increase the lifespan of the bearings by at least 30% and reduce motor vibration levels by at least 25%.
claim_elements.parameter: The tuned vibration damper is designed to reduce motor vibration levels by at least 25% and increase the lifespan of the bearings by at least 30%.
